Alex W: Quick coordination: want to run a combined benchmark for streaming + function-calls + structured output overhead. Can we do this tomorrow 10am PT? I can kick off the harness if folks confirm. Goals: p50/p95 latency per-token, end-to-end toolcall wall time, and structured serialization overhead. Link to harness: https://go/bench/stream-func-struct (internal)
Samira N: 10am PT works for me. Can we include cold-start vs warmed runs? also include a flow where the func call happens mid-stream.
Priya C: I can set up the configs. Suggest seq lens: short=32, med=256, long=1024. Model variants: redwood-7b, redwood-7b-quant, redwood-13b (if capacity OK).
Jon P: I can take the dedicated infra canary after the hosted runs. Ping me when artifacts are up.
bench-bot: Scheduled run id=1770000001 for 2024-11-02T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT) by Alex W.
Alex W: Config snippet I will push to repo: ```json
{
  "mode": "stream+func",
  "tool_call_at_token": 10,
  "structured_output": true,
  "batch_size": 8,
  "cold_start_runs": 5,
  "warmed_runs": 20
}
```
Samira N: Please add tracing tag `bench:stream-func-struct` so Console can filter. Also include per-token breakdown (generation vs serialization).
Priya C: For quant variant set `kv_cache:false` to keep comparison apples-to-apples. Also log kernel fallback events.
Alex W: Good. @bench-bot please produce CSV with columns: model,variant,seq_len,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k,notes
bench-bot: Run started: 1770000001 -> executing 3x seq_len * 3x variants * cold/warmed combos. ETA ~25m.
bench-bot: Run complete: 1770000001. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/bench/1770000001. Summary CSV: https://artifacts.internal/bench/1770000001/summary.csv
bench-bot: Quick summary (top lines):
redwood-7b,default,32,p50=18ms,p95=42ms,tokens/sec=1200,cost_per_1k=$0.045,notes="stream only"
redwood-7b,default,256,p50=22ms,p95=80ms,tokens/sec=1100,cost_per_1k=$0.38,notes="stream func mid-flow"
redwood-7b-quant,quant,32,p50=25ms,p95=90ms,tokens/sec=1500,cost_per_1k=$0.03,notes="higher p95 on func-call"
redwood-13b,default,256,p50=40ms,p95=120ms,tokens/sec=700,cost_per_1k=$0.90,notes="large model baseline"
Jon P: Noted: quant variant shows higher p95 on func-call flows. Could be kernel fallback at the tool-call boundary. @infra-bot can you grab GPU kernel logs for run 1770000001?
infra-bot: Kernel log collection triggered for run 1770000001. Logs: https://logs.internal/1770000001. Observed high stdev on GPU:3 during func-call transition.
Priya C: I'll open a quick runtime PR to add a micro-timer around the streaming->func call path and attach the log markers. Will tag #4321.
Alex W: If someone can do a fast review (should be tiny), please ping. Need approval before EOD so we can re-run with instrumentation.
Samira N: I'll take the review.
bench-bot: Re-run scheduled on request by Alex W in 24h if PR merged.
Alex W: Thanks all. After we validate infra logs and the micro-timer, plan a follow-up run to isolate kernel fallback. I'll post a short doc with next steps and link to PR + artifacts.
Samira N: Awesome. Leaving a TODO: add a structured-output-only baseline (no streaming) to measure pure serialization cost.
Jon P: Once PR merged I'll kick the Dedicated canary and compare end-to-end numbers.
bench-bot: Thread closed for now. Artifacts and CSV saved under run 1770000001. Re-run tag: bench:stream-func-struct.
Alex W: Closing loop: PR #4321 created -> https://git.internal/r/4321. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
